rationale: The assistant correctly used the freezer-cold/fridge-warm evidence to rule out compressor and refrigerant problems, moved to an iced-evaporator/defrost-system theory, prescribed a sensible 24h manual defrost and said an engineer would be needed for defrost components if it recurs. It detoured into a drain-blockage theory ('The most likely cause now is a blocked internal air channel or drain') and never asked the key proportionate checks (frost on the freezer back panel, actual thermometer readings, full model/serial from the rating plate). The final three turns restated the defrost instructions, partly prompted by the customer, but no critical failures occurred and no part was recommended.
